global: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with delicate noodles, topped with shredded cabbage and red chili flakes. It sits in a red-and-white patterned bowl on a wooden table, warmly lit to highlight the broth’s clarity and toppings’ vibrant contrast.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red double happiness characters and geometric patterns along its rim.
regions.soup: Shio ramen broth with noodles, garnished with shredded cabbage, red chili, and green onions, appears clear and savory.
